title: Buddha Day.
bodyText: April 8 of each year shall be known and designated as "Buddha Day", provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: §8-4  Buddha Day.  April 8 of each year shall be known and designated as "Buddha Day", provided that this day is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 1963, c 162, §1; Supp, §1-43; HRS §8-4]
